::: {#rem-whisper}

#### Spectrograms in speech recognition

Whisper,
a speech recognizer,
turns each recording into a [spectrogram](#def-spectrogram) on the mel scale,
which spaces its rows more finely at low frequencies than at high ones,
with 80 rows and one column every 10 milliseconds.
An encoder of [Transformer block](attention-transformers.qmd#def-transformer-block)s reads the [spectrogram](#def-spectrogram),
and a decoder writes out the text [@radford2023robust, section 2.2].

:::
